# Vendor marks

Third-party marks shown as model indicators (which AI runs in a pane, whose usage a pill reports). They identify the vendor's own product (nominative use) and are not Kolux's marks. None was taken from the old Kolux app or its install folder.

| File | Mark | Source | Taken | Terms |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `anthropic-claude-spark.svg` | Claude Spark (Clay `#D97757`) | Anthropic press kit, linked from https://www.anthropic.com/news ("Download press kit" → https://www.anthropic.com/press-kit, a zip on www-cdn.anthropic.com); file `Anthropic logos/Claude logos/3 Claude Spark/SVG/Claude Spark - Clay.svg`, unchanged | 2026-10-08 | The kit ships no terms file; the newsroom page states none. Used as supplied, unaltered, to name Anthropic's product. Txais to confirm against Anthropic's brand terms if he wants it in a public release. |
| `openai-knot.svg` | OpenAI hexagonal knot | Redrawn by hand from the public mark (six interlocking rounded links). https://openai.com/brand/ answered 403 to every fetch on 2026-10-08, so no file could be downloaded and the written terms could not be read | 2026-10-08 | Redrawn from the public mark; OpenAI's brand guidelines (openai.com/brand) govern third-party use and say the marks stay OpenAI's property and must not be shown more prominently than the app's own. Txais to confirm. |
